Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion on model fit and the latency/cost constraints you highlighted. Quick recap and a simple next step so we can get the right folks lined up:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Stellar’s primary goal: reduce inference cost by ~30% for the customer-facing agent while keeping p95 latency under 250ms.
- Key stakeholders to include: Product owner (Sara/Tom) + Platform/Infra lead for KV/cache and scaling questions.

Proposed next step: 30-minute product intro + short technical Q&A. To keep scheduling simple, I created two calendar “bundles” — pick one bundle and we’ll lock a slot and share a calendar invite with the agenda.

Bundle A — compact (best if your infra lead is tight on time):
- Tue, May 19 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed, May 20 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Bundle B — slightly wider with an early option (gives more flexibility for multi-timezone attendees):
- Thu, May 21 — 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Thu, May 21 — 3:30–4:00 PM PT
- Fri, May 22 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Please reply with: 1) which bundle you prefer (A or B), 2) who from your team will join (we recommend Product + Infra), and 3) any must-cover items (e.g., compliance, on-prem constraints).

I’ve cc’d Karthik (our technical lead) who can run the deep-dive portion. Once you pick a bundle we’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short agenda.

Thanks —
